pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular sub-polygonal dark regions with sharp, jagged edge gradients. Geometric area of individual patches is heterogeneous, with larger regions on the upper flank and significantly smaller, more rounded patches near the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thick, continuous network of light-colored negative space. Topological junctions are clearly defined, predominantly forming tri-radial and quadri-radial nodes with high pixel-width consistency across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the cervical and cranial-thoracic ridge against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized region of textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation on the upper-mid flank where discrete patch boundaries are replaced by a diffuse, darker texture.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear indentation or scar-like feature is visible on the mid-lateral flank, bisecting the pelage pattern. A prominent structural protrusion or lump is visible on the dorsal ridge line at the posterior-most visible point of the back.
